text:
harper: Quick pitch 1-week PLG play: 'Ignite Credits' 1 live 30m demo + 5 short how-to clips + Prompt Starter Pack + 120 credits auto-grant. Objective: increase signup -> first-generate within 48h by ~25%. :spark:

sam: Nice. Primary metric = % of new signups that make >=1 /v1/generate within 48h. Secondary: day7 retention and credit redemption.

jun: Ops: recommend auto-issue promo via `/v1/internal/promos/issue` for non-enterprise domains and cohort tag `ignite-credits`. I can wire the webhook; need promo id and email copy by Thu EOD.

marta: Launch angles: (A) "Run real prompts now" dev-focused; (B) "Starter packs for teams" product-focused; (C) benchmark teaser showing a 256-token example. I'll draft hero copy and 3 social variants.

harper: Experiment arms: A) 120 credits + prompt pack (baseline), B) 120 credits + guided console tour, C) 240 credits + prompt pack. Target ~300 signups/arm. Also test immediate vs gated credit delivery.

sam: Tracking: utm_campaign=ignite-credits, utm_source=social|newsletter, prompt_pack=starter. Amplitude events: webinar_signup, promo_issued, first_generate. I'll add a small dashboard for same-day monitoring.

jun: Automation flow: registration webhook -> growth-webhooks -> promo service -> email with one-click "Run this sample" button. Also add query param `credit_flow=auto|gated` for segmentation.

marta: Social copy draft: "Ignite Credits: get credits + runnable starter prompts. Live demo + on-demand clips." I'll post A/B headlines tomorrow AM.

metric-bot: Note: ensure last_message_ts >= first_message_ts.

promo-bot: Promo placeholder created: id=IG-120-PRE, auto_issue=false until ops toggle.

harper: Final checklist: copy & socials (marta), promo id & email templates (jun), webhook & cohort routing (sam), experiment splits & dashboard (sam/aaron), guided tour prototype (product). Quick 15m sync tomorrow 10am PT. :rocket:
